name: Bootable
description: Write and verify ISO, IMG, RAW, and compressed images on USB or SD media. Available as a native desktop app and mouse-enabled TUI for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
audience: Linux, Windows, and macOS users who create bootable USB or SD media.

features.title: Find images
features.description: Browse DistroWatch, Omarchy, and Raspberry Pi images, or select a local file.

features.title: Review the target
features.description: Lists removable media only, excludes system disks, and revalidates the device before erasure.

features.title: Write and verify
features.description: Checks publisher hashes and written bytes, supports cancellation, and flags incomplete media.
